about.paragraph: Ochaworth Leadership and Community Development Initiative (CAC/RN: 7290687) is a registered non-governmental organization and network of impactful, youth-led, women’s rights advocates. We are committed to promoting equality and social justice by equipping women and girls to recognize their worth, live it boldly, and birth the “more” within them.

card2.heading: Ready To Change The World?
card2.paragraph: Your support fuels projects that rehabilitates and reintegrate survivors of Gender Based Violence (GBV), feed widows & orphans, educate the less privileged, Pad a Girl child, Create Cancer awareness and heal communities across the Nation.

slides.label: Ochaworth
slides.sub: Join our mission to promote and protect the rights of women and girls through advocacy, empowerment, mentoring, and leadership development, working to eliminate gender-based violence.

slides.label: Pad A Girl
slides.sub: Because of your generosity, hundreds of girls across 4 states in Nigeria received sanitary pads, menstrual health education, and the reassurance that their dreams should never be interrupted by period poverty.

slides.label: World Cancer Day Walk
slides.sub: Cancer affects millions of lives, but early awareness, prevention, and actions can save lives. This is more than a walk, it’s a movement of love and solidarity with cancer survivors, caregivers, and advocates.

services.title: Empower Women & Girls
services.desc: We equip women and girls to lead, make informed decisions, and claim their rights through our leadership boothcamps, right educstion workshop, life skill training, and the feminist fronteir podcast.

services.title: Stomp Out Cancer Initiative
services.desc: We sensitize the populace on cancer prevention and early detection through our community health outreaches, cancer education, screening linkages, teach self exams, family history drives, free screening and cancer walk.

services.title: Save Spaces and Access Project
services.desc: We provide menstrual health education and pad distribution drives, save space hubs for counselling and skills training though pad a girl school outreaches and partner with clinics for sexual and reproductive health right referrals.

services.title: Widows and Orphans Dignity Iniative
services.desc: We provide legal protect, ecomonic independence for widows and orphans through "Know the law" clinic for inheritance rights, widow corporatives for income generaiton, school support for orphans, and town meetings with traditional leaders.

services.title: SafeHer: End Gender-Based Violence
services.desc: Prevent, respond to, and advocate against all forms of violence against women and girls though our holistic action such as referral pathways, Medical/legal/psychological services, emergency safe space partnerships, community sensitization on GBV laws, skills training, start up kit for survivors to rebuild financial independence, annual 16 days activism campaigns, GBV reporting to track trends and inform policy.
